# Macca Lab

> An independent project for experiments and editorial content. Macca Blog publishes sourced coverage of Grand Theft Auto, Rockstar Games and related gaming stories.

Macca Blog links stories to their sources and labels rumors and unresolved reports as unconfirmed.

## Public pages

- [Macca Lab | GTA 6 & Rockstar News, Analysis and Projects](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/): Independent GTA 6, GTA Online and Rockstar Games news, analysis and source-backed coverage from Macca Blog, plus Macca Lab projects.
- [About Macca Lab](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/about/): Learn about Macca Lab, an independent project for experiments and editorial content, including sourced GTA and Rockstar coverage on Macca Blog.
- [Contact Macca Lab](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/contact/): Contact Macca Lab by email or through the official Macca the Gator Instagram account.
- [Corrections & Updates | Macca Lab](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/corrections/): How Macca Blog handles corrections, clarifications and material updates to published coverage.
- [Editorial Policy | Macca Lab](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/editorial-policy/): How Macca Blog sources, labels, updates and monetizes GTA and Rockstar coverage.
- [GTA 6 | Macca Blog](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/gta-6/): Source-backed GTA 6 coverage, updates, analysis and explainers from Macca Blog.
- [Privacy Policy | Macca Lab](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/privacy/): Privacy information for Macca Lab and Macca Blog, including website data, cookies, partner advertising, future Google AdSense, and the YouTube publishing integration.
- [Rockstar Games | Macca Blog](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/rockstar-games/): Rockstar Games news, studio updates, legal stories, releases and official announcements.
- [Latest GTA & Rockstar Stories | Macca](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/social/): The latest GTA and Rockstar stories from Macca Blog, plus Macca the Gator on YouTube and Instagram.

## Blog and feeds

- [Macca Blog](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/blog/): News, sourced reporting and analysis.
- [RSS feed](https://macca-lab.onrender.com/blog/feed.xml): Recent blog articles.
